verdict.rationale: The pack covers instance pricing models (on-demand, interruptible bidding, reserved pre-pay discounts), marketplace price competition and autobilling top-ups. None of it states per-second or per-minute billing granularity, or that charges stop when an instance is stopped. The Serverless line about paying for execution rather than GPU rental time describes a different product mode and gives no billing granularity, so it does not establish this instance-billing story.
